description: Record a payment against an invoice or credit note. Reduces the invoice's AmountDue and posts to the specified bank/payment account.

Account.description: Bank/payment account reference — provide AccountID or Code (e.g. '090' for a bank account).

CurrencyRate.description: FX rate if invoice currency differs from org base currency.

Reference.description: Free-text reference (bank ref, check number, etc).

name: create_payment
